sloka: वसिष्ठादिभिर्ऋत्विग्भिर्याचितो भगवांस्तत: ।उवाच तं भरद्वाज: प्रसादाद्भरतं वच: ॥ २.९०.१९
transliteration: vasiṣṭhādibhirṛtvigbhiryācito bhagavāṁstata: ।uvāca taṁ bharadvāja: prasādādbharataṁ vaca: ॥ 2.90.19

translations.english: Likewise besought by Vasistha and other priests, the venerable Bharadwaja was pleased to tell Bharata:
